_about: Dated anchor towns for the capture of German Reich territory outside 1939 Poland, October 1944 – 8 May 1945 (see build-borders.py): by the Red Army (`soviet`) or by the Western Allies (`allied`), each the first day the place is shown as taken; `soviet: null` without `allied` means German-held to the end of the map. Every place in Reich territory takes the date of its nearest anchor within `radiusKm` (default 100 for Red Army captures, 120 for the Western Allies, whose dated towns are more evenly spread); beyond that it stays German. Anchors marked `pocket` (Wrocław, Żuławy, the Vistula Spit) are circles of `radiusKm` that override their surroundings, because they held out longer. `by`, `approx` and `confidence: search-quote` as in the other anchor files.
